name: Radial Basis Function Interpolation
definition: A method enabling interpolation on non-uniform, scattered 3D data points without requiring a structured grid. It uses kernel-based weighting centered at each data site for flexible surface reconstruction.
summary: Radial Basis Function Interpolation approximates scalar fields from scattered 3D data without a grid, using kernel-based weighting to handle irregular domains, though it incurs high computational costs.
